items.requirement: Required dependencies are explicit and absence is caught at construction/build/startup
items.gap: Constructor capability types are covered; comprehensive per-domain nil/typed-nil required-input matrix is not established. Several standalone constructors permit nil fixtures.

items.requirement: Optional integrations have deterministic disabled behavior
items.gap: Named cases prove selected providers; full inventory of optional integrations is not closed.

items.requirement: Every callback group is wired exactly once and routes payloads
items.gap: Current-source combined test result pending. These controlled callbacks do not prove deployed/physical media.

items.requirement: Startup failure cleanup and shutdown ownership
items.gap: Known paths have behavior tests; exhaustive worker/resource ownership matrix and combined race proof remain open.

items.requirement: Domain grouped composition; initServices contains no business logic
items.gap: Voice/media and music persistence are grouped. initServices remains a long constructor chain with delivery mode selection, configuration setters and callback registration; domain-by-domain separation/review remains.

items.requirement: HTTP route manifest and authorization gates preserved
items.gap: Current-source broad run pending; route tests do not prove all runtime authorization scenarios.
AST definition/call counts cannot prove selected provider identity, scope or callback behavior; use behavioral integration contracts alongside it.

limits: Evidence index and gap audit only; files are inspected for scope, not treated as passing test results.
